scope.summary: Typed resolved local SYS-owner proof in fga_closure: SYS-owned local relations need no FGA catalog probe (Oracle refuses FGA policies on SYS objects, ORA-46399); non-SYS, mixed, lowercase-spoofed, remote or unresolved identities keep the existing probe/refusal (555864bd).
out_of_scope: External-client proof of SELECT 1 FROM DUAL for a least-privilege account (R36 .6.12 already admits it with an observation; this bead removes the observation for SYS-only reads).
